text: Think back to the first day of this school year. Tell me how the time since then has felt for you.

question: Q1
text: Hm. At the start it was really slow, like the first two weeks felt like a month, because everything was new, new teachers, a new room, and I had to find my way. And now I'm kind of surprised it's already almost Christmas.

speaker: P
question: Q1
text: Yes, the class trip to Munich. That was in October and it feels like it was ages ago, but also it is like a marker, like before the trip and after the trip. The weeks after the trip are kind of one big block in my head.
